full_judgment: 3. The defendant No.1 contested the suit by filing written, statement alleging, inter alia, that the suit is not maintainable and; the suit is barred by limitation. The case of the defendant, in short, is that the land measuring 2.45 acres of C.S. Khatian No. 46 of Mouza Ganoara originally belonged to Moajan and Malik and they sold 12 annas sham to Jinnat Khan and 4 annas share to Kashem Ali. Jinnat Khan died leaving Annat Khan and Khatun Bibi as heirs and accordingly his interest in the suit land devolved upon them. Annat Khan died leaving two sons, namely, Hamej and Kanchan and two daughters namely, Asia and Rabiya as heirs. Annat Khan's heirs being owners of 1.32 acres settled the same land to Ajahar and others on 01.05.1950 and the S.A. Khatian was accordingly prepared. The plaintiff’s kabala was collusive and forged and the S.A. Khatian recorded owners were not made parties in the suit. So the suit is liable to be dismissed.
